translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content: Nkunga Davidi kuidi pfumu minyimbidi ; kayimbidila mu lusinga.

content.text: Wa yamikina kuama, e Nzambi
tamba dikutu mulusambulu luama
Tona kusukinina ntoto, ngeyo ndintela ;
nditela bu ntimꞌama wumevonga ngolo ;
wundati va mbata dibanga
diodi dindutidi mu nangama.
Bila ngeyo wuba suamunu kiama ;
ngeyo wuba nzo yizangama ayi yingolo
va ntuala mutu weti kundenda.
Ndiela zingila mu nzo aku yi ngoto ;
mu zithangu zioso ayi ndiela suamina
ku tsi mavavi maku.
Bila ngeyo, wuwa zikhanu ziama, e Nzambi ;
ngeyo wuphana kiuka ki batu bobo beti kinzika dizina diaku.
Buela bilumbu bi luzingu lu ntinu,
mimvu miandi mu diambu di zitsungu ziwombo.
Bika kavuanda va kundu ki kipfumu
va meso ma Nzambi mu zithangu zioso ;
tula luzolo luaku ayi kikhuikizi kiaku mu kunkeba.
Buna ndiela yimbidila nzitusu mu diambu di dizina diaku
mu zithangu zioso ayi ndiela dedikisa zikhanu ziama
lumbu ka lumbu.
